items.why: A real server, Docker and an Android emulator cannot run inside the red gate. Evidence: the tripwire and wire jobs of ci.yml green on the pull request's head commit; release-evidence/wire/summary.txt from the wire job holding the line `transport-probe-then-signed-in jellyscale T3-05 pass` and a pass line for every other T3-05 pair, with no fail line; the `[fixture-up] ports ...` line in both jobs' logs; and the same summary from the implementer's own pnpm tv:wire --task T3-05 run. The unit half is frozen in scripts/tv-wire-fixture-ports.test.ts (listed under files, tests named `T3-27 item 2:`). The wire job is not a required check until T10-01, so the PR is not marked ready and auto-merge is not enabled until that job is green on the head commit.
